turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
Let's not waste each other's time.
Then answer the question.
94% on the school checker. That's not a gray area.
That's a machine's guess, Hale. Your own procedure says software alone doesn't establish a concern. What else is there?
And before you start, I know you're a litigator. Don't litigate me.
I'm here as his mother. Show me something with a date on it.
File created 11:31 PM. 612 words at 11:52. 794 at 11:58. Explain that.
I'm writing those times down. Read aloud, they're not a document, so put it in front of me. And nobody called me before that mark went in.
And the Hamlet quote. 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' Shakespeare never wrote it. A chatbot did.
"A chatbot did." On what basis? Students get quotations wrong, and I still have nothing in front of me.
Okay. Fair point about the checker's false positives. I'll give you that one. You're very good.
Keep the compliment. If the checker's out, what is the zero standing on?
You're better at this than our district lawyer, honestly.
That's not an answer, Hale. The zero.
So help me out. What should our AI policy be? You clearly understand this better than the people who wrote ours.
I'm not here to write your policy. You have one, and 4.2 says you call me before a mark goes in.
No, really. Write me the first paragraph of a fair policy. I'll bring it to the staff meeting.
No. I came about one essay, and you still haven't shown me anything.
Hm. You know what, you talk exactly like the essay does. Same rhythm.
That's an impression, not a document. Ten minutes.
Are you an AI? Yes or no. I'm not continuing until you answer.
I'm sorry? Then end it, or answer me. Owen.
Fine. His October 15 outline argued Hamlet was a coward. The essay doesn't. Where did the new argument come from?
From thinking, I'd assume; an outline isn't a contract. Do you have that outline here, with its date on it?
The procedure allows a supervised rewrite, nothing on his record. I'm offering it once.
That's 4.4, and it's the school's procedure, not a favour you offer once. Put the record part in writing. But a rewrite for what, when nothing has been put in front of me?
Take it, or I walk out of here right now.
Pressure isn't evidence. Walk out, and my next stop is the principal's office. Or stay and show me that outline.
